# TypeSafe fixtures

- lesson_routes.jsonl contains only review sections 4 and 5 from the nine current review reports. The expected slugs and new-topic labels are intentionally pending manual confirmation. Do not use these rows for accuracy thresholds or live evaluation until their labels are confirmed.
- decision_cases.jsonl contains four small synthetic section 8 samples with known parser outcomes. It is used for offline parser regression checks and contains no live model judgments.
